senses.gloss: ch., pret. <cite ref="H01800"><he>חָשׁ</he></cite>, part. <cite ref="H01800"><he>חָשׁ</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00746"><he>חָיֵישׁ</he></cite>, same,

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 73:21">Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 21</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 26:10">Targ. Prov. XXVI, 10</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:17">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>חש ביוקרא דלבא</he> suffered with heaviness of the heart.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>וחֲשָׁאִי בנפשאי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וחֲשִׁי</he>, Ms. P. <he>וחשי בי</he>, fr. <cite ref="H01801"><he>חֲשָׁא</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01827"><he>חֲשִׁי</he></cite>) and I felt the cooling effect from the hair &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 12:3">Targ. Y. Num. XII, 3</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ bot. <he>הואיל וחש לה … מֵיחוּשׁ</he> since R. Z. cared to do it, we must do likewise.

<cite ref="Pesachim 84a">Pes. 84ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 46a">Yoma 46ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="L00003"><he>לא</he></cite> (<cite ref="H00746"><he>חייש</he></cite>) <he>חש לקימחיה</he> cares not what flour he grinds (what argument he offers).

<cite ref="Ketubot 21a:12">Keth. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>וחש … לב״ד טועין</he> and S. took into consideration that a court might have a mistaken opinion (and was more explicit in his document than the law required); <cite ref="Yevamot 106a:16">Yeb. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>דחַיְישִׁינָן וכ׳</he> for we must take into consideration &c.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 164a">B. Bath. 164ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 164a">Ib.</cite> (<he>ונֵיחוּש</he>) <he>ולֵיחוּשׁ וכ׳</he> but should we not apprehend that perhaps &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:9">Targ. Cant. II, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 141:1">Targ. Ps. CXLI, 1</cite> <he>חִישׁ לי</he> hasten to my help.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:44">Targ. Y. Deut. I, 44</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00213"><he>חֲדַר</he></cite>.
